deployments_detail.use: AI systems to reduce food waste and optimize logistics across major business processes

Ahold Delhaize USA (ADUSA / Retail Business Services) uses RELEX AI-driven end-to-end forecasting and replenishment to optimize fresh and center-store product availability and freshness across distribution centers serving Food Lion, Hannaford and other brands (1,200+ stores). [RELEX Solutions]

AI-powered dynamic discounting to reduce food waste: an algorithm sets markdowns on perishable items based on expiration date, location, promotions, weather, historical sales and in-store stock, displayed on electronic shelf labels. Launched as a pilot at Albert Heijn. [Wasteless (AI pricing) / Pricer (electronic shelf labels)]

Automated fulfillment centers processing thousands of online grocery orders daily, improving delivery speed and cutting costs

Conversational AI assistant in the @AH Employee App for store staff, answering questions on restocking, product locations and customer inquiries, with barcode scanning and store floorplans. Piloted in 8 stores, expanding to 25 by summer 2025 and rollout planned to all ~700 owned stores. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI (Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Database for PostgreSQL)]

Steijn, a generative-AI customer assistant in the Albert Heijn app that suggests recipes from 20,000+ Allerhande recipes, recognizes fridge contents from a photo, and learns dietary preferences to drive shopping and reduce food waste. Live in the AH app (5M users), built by 8 developers in ~3 months. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry (Foundry Models, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Content Safety)]

Ahold Delhaize invested via W23 Global in Harmonya, whose AI enriches fragmented product data into contextual insights; the retailer uses the platform to improve product discovery and deliver more personalized/relevant shopping experiences across physical and digital channels. [Harmonya (W23 Global venture fund)]

AI-driven personalization at scale: Ahold Delhaize's U.S. brands delivered over 14.2 billion personalized offers in 2025 (up 18% YoY), using AI to help customers shop, cook and save, including targeted notifications on expiring coupons and tailored deals through local-brand loyalty apps. [Inmar Intelligence (offer management/promotion engine)]

Albert Heijn's Rasa-powered conversational AI customer-service agent handling inquiries across web, mobile and WhatsApp (subscription cancellations, order changes, loyalty issues, auto-crediting missing digital stamps), working alongside human agents. Fully operational at scale serving ~1.2B annual customers across ~1,200 stores. [Rasa (Rasa CALM)]
deployments_detail.value: 50% contact deflection rate; 42% quality score; +0.5 pt CSAT (5-pt scale); missing-stamp contacts reduced 80%

deployments_detail.use: Ahold Delhaize USA deploys GitHub Copilot and Azure AI services across its engineering org (800+ repositories) to automate testing, accelerate delivery and improve code quality, as part of a cloud-native e-commerce modernization supporting 1B+ annual customer interactions. [GitHub Copilot / Microsoft Azure AI]
deployments_detail.value: up to 40% improvement in engineering delivery speed; features shipped in hours vs weeks

deployments_detail.use: Ahold Delhaize invested via W23 Global in Protex AI, a computer-vision solution that integrates with existing CCTV to proactively identify and reduce workplace/customer safety hazards across retail operations, shifting from reactive to preventive safety. [Protex AI (W23 Global venture fund)]
